segments.contextAfter: **Use a DNS domain name, IP address, or range of IP addresses** — In iOS 17, iPadOS 17, and macOS 14, you can use an IPv4 address, for example `192.168.42.63`, or an IPv6 address, for example `2001:db8:12::34`.
